name: Tejas Rastogi
summary: The hairless boy of the 2006 Hindi film Alag, raised in a dark basement, who has telepathy, telekinesis and a magnetic touch and must choose between hiding and using his gifts.
origin: Tejas is the only son of widower Hemant Rastogi in Mahabaleshwar. Because he cannot stand sunlight, his father keeps him in a basement with books. After his father's death the police find him, and he is placed in an institute for young offenders, where his telekinetic and telepathic powers begin to show. Scientists and a ruthless doctor then try to exploit him. Akshay Kapoor played him in Ashu Trikha's film.
creators: Tagore Almeida, Sanjay Masoom and Ashu Trikha (writers)
powers: Extraordinary intellect from years of reading
affiliations: P. R. Institute for young offenders (placed there)

storyline.title: The boy in the basement
storyline.beat: After his father dies, police discover Tejas living in a basement, where he spent his whole life because of extreme sensitivity to sunlight.

storyline.title: A hairless outsider
storyline.beat: Placed in an institute, Tejas is shunned by the other boys when his telekinesis appears, and an accident there goes terribly wrong.

storyline.title: The Rana household
storyline.beat: Tejas wins the trust of the wealthy Rana family by waking Gayatri Rana from a coma-like state, but scientists begin to chase him for experiments.

storyline.title: The glass chamber
storyline.beat: Dr Richard Dyer abducts Tejas and locks him in a glass chamber, and Tejas's rage finally breaks loose with consequences that send him back to his basement.

gossip.text: Ten stars, including Shah Rukh Khan, Priyanka Chopra, Abhishek Bachchan and Preity Zinta, appear in the song Sabse Judaa Sabse Alag.
Wikipedia's Akshay Kapoor page calls Alag a remake of the 1995 American film Powder, while the Rediff review says only that it is based considerably on it.
Akshay Kapoor spent a week alone with no TV or phone to prepare for playing Tejas.
Alag opened one week before Krrish, on 16 June 2006.

quiz.q: Why does Tejas spend his early life in a basement?
options: He is hiding from the police
He is being trained as a spy
He is extremely sensitive to sunlight
quiz.why: Doctors say his extreme sensitivity to sunlight is why his father kept him indoors.

quiz.q: What does the title Alag mean in English?
quiz.why: Alag translates as different, which suits the film's outsider hero.

quiz.q: Which power is NOT shown for Tejas in the sources?
quiz.why: Sources list telekinesis, telepathy, magnetism and lightning, but not flight.

quiz.q: What does Tejas do with a spoon in the cafeteria?
options: Sets it vibrating until cutlery flies to him
quiz.why: He sets the spoon vibrating, building a magnetic field that drags cutlery across the room.

theme.tagline: Different, haloed and kept in the dark.

timeline.title: Alag opens in Hindi cinemas
timeline.note: The sci-fi film, directed by Ashu Trikha, is released on 16 June 2006 with Akshay Kapoor and Dia Mirza.

timeline.title: Called Bollywood's first mutant film
timeline.note: A Rediff review calls it Bollywood's first mutant film and notes it draws on the American film Powder.

timeline.title: A week before Krrish
timeline.note: Hrithik Roshan's Krrish follows on 23 June, so two Indian superhero films reach cinemas in one fortnight.

timeline.title: A box-office disappointment
timeline.note: Wikipedia lists the Rs 8 crore film as earning only Rs 56 lakh at the box office.

facts.text: Rediff describes Tejas as a hairless boy, brows and all, with an almost-visible halo around his head. The title Alag means different, and he looks it.
Rediff says Tejas's father locks him away in a darkened basement because he cannot bear sunlight, and for 18 years the boy does nothing but read.
A Rediff review called Alag Bollywood's first mutant film and said it was based considerably on the 1995 American film Powder.
The film cost about Rs 8 crore, yet Wikipedia lists its gross at only Rs 56 lakh, well under a tenth of the budget.
In the cafeteria, bullies dare him to balance a spoon on his nose, so he sets it vibrating until a magnetic field drags cutlery across the room.
Akshay Kapoor spent a week alone in his flat, without TV or phone, to feel Tejas's isolation, and he read Lord of the Flies for the same reason.
An April 2006 preview mentions a scene in which the hero interacts with about 1,000 butterflies.
Bollywood Hungama says radios and TVs misbehave near Tejas, and in thunderstorms he behaves like a lightning rod.
Tejas's eyes turn red when he is a small boy, so his father takes him to doctors, who say his extreme sensitivity to sunlight is the cause.
When Purva hands Tejas wraparound sunglasses to go outside, Rediff jokes the idea could have saved his late father all the money spent on opaque black curtains.
Akshay Kapoor wrote a personal diary for Tejas, imagining what happened to him at age 5, 6, 10 and so on, to get into the character.
Akshay says he learned only after his audition that Tejas has no hair and no eyebrows, because the full script was narrated to him afterwards.
Akshay Kapoor was born in India, moved to the United States at six months, grew up in New Jersey and trained in theatre, with some Broadway plays behind him.
Producer Subi Samuel was a Bollywood photographer, and the Tribune says Alag was his first time producing a film.
The trailer opens with the idea that God creates everyone, but sometimes picks one person and makes him different, which is what the title Alag means.
In the song Sabse Judaa Sabse Alag, ten stars including Shah Rukh Khan and Priyanka Chopra arrive one after another like angels, each speaking lines about Tejas.
Rediff says Tejas has no supervillain to fight, and that the lack of one is why the film struggles to call him a true superhero.
Rediff teases that the bald hero lies in bed dreaming of a life with hair and Hrithik-style dance steps, in song bits it finds out of place.
Akshay says the story is about people judging Tejas by how he looks instead of understanding his heart.
Akshay Kapoor's first film, Popcorn Khao! Mast Ho Jao in 2004, was a glamorous teen romance, so a bald, brow-less hero was a big change.

kidSummary: Tejas is a bald boy who has to live in a dark basement because sunlight hurts him, so he spends his childhood reading. Outside, he finds he can move things with his mind and sense thoughts, and he just wants to be accepted. The ending is bittersweet.
